description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.
